newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 19.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Wednesday edition:

WASHINGTON - Alexis Herman appeared headed for easy Senate approval as secretary of labor after a confirmation hearing that barely touched on her possible White House role in fund-raising efforts by the Democratic Party.

WASHINGTON - Host Marriott Corp. in Bethesda, Maryland, tentatively agreed to purchase 29 senior living communities for $540 million from Marriott International Inc. to enter the increasingly popular housing market for aging Americans.
WASHINGTON - Novell Inc. named Sun Microsystems Inc.'s top technologist to be its chairman and chief executive.

WASHINGTON - A transatlantic banana war appears to be ending in a victory for the United States -- and for one of America's most prodigious political donors, Carl Lindner of Chiquita Brands International Inc.
